verdict.rationale: The evidence shows flag-based staged rollouts and a manual ability to turn a flag off when something looks wrong, but nothing documents metric guardrails that detect a regression or trigger an automatic rollback. The management APIs usable from CI are developer building blocks a user could script around, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can guard a rollout with metrics so a regression is detected and the release is rolled back automatically
